title: Receive bytes
summary: WebSockets: Receive bytes. Send bytes 4, 5 and 6.
introduction: A binary message carries bytes rather than text. This server sends three small byte values.

blocks.text: Run npm init -y and npm install ws@8 in a practice folder. Save each example as lesson.mjs and run node lesson.mjs. Each file starts a local server and test client, prints a result, then closes both.

blocks.title: Receive bytes

blocks.text: The Buffer contains bytes 1, 2 and 3. The client spreads those bytes and joins their numeric values.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Do not decode arbitrary binary bytes as if they were normal text.
